title: A FIRST! The ATTP MASTERS Cup!
excerpt: An incredible event in the world of table tennis in the Republic of Moldova
body_html:
Table tennis is bringing together more and more people of all ages. In ATTP’s Super Cup series tournaments, anyone can compete on equal terms with outstanding masters of the sport, and everyone has a chance of an honourable place on the podium.

Clearly, we are all now eagerly awaiting the start of the Masters tournament, and some candidates are already familiar with the regulations of this event — one of a special scale, the like of which has never been held in Moldova.

The ATTP Organising Committee is in constant contact with various top players and coaches to take every detail of the planned event into account. We are confident it will be one of the most remarkable and prestigious table tennis tournaments in the history of the Republic of Moldova. We have come a long way in the level of preparation and organisation, thanks to the well-coordinated work of the ATTP organising committee and our partners/sports associations.

The experience gained at tournaments held under the auspices of ATTP in 2023 plays a substantial role in taking the ATTP Masters tournament to a much higher level. ATTP’s CEO is in regular contact with the organising committee, paying particular attention to preparations for the event. The standards are high, but they are consistently met. It is already clear that the first ATTP Masters table tennis tournament in the Republic of Moldova will be held at the highest level.

In conclusion, I would like to note that in table tennis competitions under the auspices of ATTP there are no losers — only new experiences and motivation to get better.

The words of the famous martial arts master Jigoro Kano fit perfectly here: “It is not important to be better than someone else, but to be better than yesterday.”
